rationale: Multipart body missing file or fileName part now fails a null check in the mapper; before, the map lacked the key and failed later or proceeded. Exact error status unclear.
Synchronization added around permissions computation and reset; single-threaded results identical, only a race fixed.
Default contentType changes from Guava JSON_UTF_8.type() ('application') to application/json, and an Accept header (default */*) is now added to outgoing request headers.
Only new constants added; no behaviour changes.

Cluster-scope normalization and dedup merged into one function; namespace defaulting and dedup unchanged, tracking is re-set for defaulted namespaces with the same destination namespace; error message text differs.
Batch size config lookup passes realm context from call context instead of call context object; refactor of internal task handler.
Config validator sets an empty server address path to '/'; startup config normalization, effect on served requests not shown.

Endpoint descriptors returned for shells/submodels now use rebuilt hrefs (prefix after server path, callbackAddress option), repository hrefs without id, and subprotocol fields; previous href values differ.
Requests with Origin starting http://127.0.0.1 now get CORS headers set; before they went through the other origin checks.
Cancel of reusable-workflow callers restructured: callers with children reloaded instead of re-cancelled; intended end state and returned jobs same.
Password policy failures now return typed text-package validation errors instead of plain errors; the error message or id rendered to clients likely changes, status unknown.
After sending 405 for unknown method, request is now marked handled; effect on final response not determinable.
Empty display name check removed from controller and passed as a flag to CheckPermissionForUpdateUser, whose body is not provided.
Eval result segmentID is now set only for the segment returning a variant; before it held the last evaluated segment ID even with no match.
